TARCian Run 2016 A STRONG showing of 2,200 runners arrived bright and early for the second edition of the TARCian Run to raise funds for a RM30mil student centre. Organised by the Tunku Abdul Rahman University College (TAR UC) and its TARCian Alumni Association (TAA) at the main campus in Kuala Lumpur last Sunday, the run featured two other events taking place at the the institution’s Johor campus and Sabah branch simultaneously.
